login.title: Sign in
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired — sign in again

signup.title: Create an account

roles.TENANT_hint: Search, save homes and book viewings

signup.emailHint: We’ll send a link to verify it.

verifyEmail.title: Verifying your email…
verifyEmail.checking: One moment — we are checking the link.
verifyEmail.successText: {{email}} is confirmed. You can now publish homes and book viewings.

verifyEmail.missing: The link is incomplete — open it from the email again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we’ll send a link to choose a new one.
forgotPassword.sentText: If {{email}} has a Keyhaven account, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Every other device is signed out once you save it.
resetPassword.missing: The link is incomplete — open it from the email again.

verification.banner: Verify your email address — we sent a link to {{email}}.
verification.resent: A new verification email is on its way to {{email}}.

idle.title: Still there?
idle.text: For your security you’ll be signed out in {{time}} because of inactivity.

actions.auth.password_changed: Password changed — other devices signed out
actions.auth.password_reset: Password reset through the emailed link — all devices signed out
actions.auth.session_evicted: Oldest session signed out — more than 10 devices
actions.auth.sign_in_locked: Sign-in blocked for 15 minutes — too many wrong passwords
